page.overview:
Who is Yuanpu Cui?

18 February 2008) is a Chinese racing driver currently racing in the OK Junior classes with Kart Republic (Argenti Motorsport) and is part of the Mercedes Junior Team. At the age of 13, he's one of the youngest drivers to join the Mercedes Junior Team; third to Alex Powell who joined at 11, and second to Andrea Kimi Antonelli at 12.
